_comment: Web-standard code (fetch/WebCrypto/atob) that must EMIT dist/ and is tested under Node but consumed by workerd. Neither workers.json (noEmit) nor base.json unmodified fits: extend base.json and override lib/types. lib: DOM here supplies Web-standard globals (JsonWebKey, SubtleCrypto, fetch) - not actual DOM; this package touches no document/window. types: [] is load-bearing - it keeps Node-only globals from type-checking in code that runs in workerd, where they do not exist.
